name: SLYP
description: LLM agents have been increasingly adopted for solving security tasks. However, existing evaluations usually require source code access, while commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) binaries dominate deployed software and require reasoning from stripped, optimized machine code. This discrepancy raises an important question: can modern LLM agents reason about vulnerabilities in critical COTS binaries? Motivated by this question, we build SLYP, a REACT-style pipeline for end-to-end vulnerability discovery and validation of COTS binaries.
